record_title: Boundary attractors and exact degeneration rates for largest-dihedral-angle bisection
provenance: Asymptotic dynamical analysis and parameter generalization of the invariant largest-dihedral-angle-bisection recurrence introduced in arXiv:2609.18788.
limitations: The general theorem concerns a structured tetrahedral family and a local basin near its degenerate boundary fixed point; it does not classify all LAB branches or prove a full-dimensional open basin in unrestricted tetrahedral shape space. The c=1/sqrt(2) threshold is specific to this boundary-fixed-point mechanism. Exact-arithmetic asymptotics are proved, but no finite-precision mesh-generation stability theorem is given. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.
